// Part: room: gazebo. Interior of the octagonal pavilion (box x10..16, y2..6, z78..84), furnished by the interior designer.
// Layout: a round table on a dark-oak fence post at the centre (13,81) with a slab top and a flower pot on it; a ring of
// stair seats facing it (north and south seats at z79/z83, east and west seats at x11/x15); flower pots in the four
// corners; five hanging lanterns (four corners and the centre) under the solid cone ceiling at y7.
// The entrance lane runs down x13 from the north opening (13,2,77) to the table; (13,79) and (13,80) stay clear.
import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

export function build(g) {
  const legend = {
    F: "flower_pot", // corner pots on the floor (y2)
    P: "flower_pot", // the table's pot (y4, on the slab top)
    n: ["dark_oak_stairs", { facing: "north", half: "bottom" }], // seat on the north side, back to the north
    s: ["dark_oak_stairs", { facing: "south", half: "bottom" }], // seat on the south side, back to the south
    w: ["dark_oak_stairs", { facing: "west", half: "bottom" }], // seat on the west side, back to the west
    e: ["dark_oak_stairs", { facing: "east", half: "bottom" }], // seat on the east side, back to the east
    T: "dark_oak_fence", // table post (y2)
    t: ["dark_oak_slab", { type: "top" }], // table top (y3, top half)
    L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }], // hanging lanterns (y6), from the cone's solid ceiling at y7
  };
  // x10..16 across, z78..84 down; the outer ring is the pavilion's balustrade and columns, left alone.
  const blank = ["       ", "       ", "       ", "       ", "       ", "       ", "       "];
  const y2 = [
    "       ", // z78
    " Fn nF ", // z79
    " w   e ", // z80
    " w T e ", // z81
    " w   e ", // z82
    " Fs sF ", // z83
    "       ", // z84
  ];
  const y3 = ["       ", "       ", "       ", "   t   ", "       ", "       ", "       "];
  const y4 = ["       ", "       ", "       ", "   P   ", "       ", "       ", "       "];
  const y6 = ["       ", " L   L ", "       ", "   L   ", "       ", " L   L ", "       "];
  // layers from y2: [floor furniture, table top, table pot, (y5 air), hanging lanterns]
  layers(g, [10, 2, 78], legend, [y2, y3, y4, blank, y6]);
}

The four corner hanging lanterns moved one cell inward to (12,6,80), (14,6,80), (12,6,82), (14,6,82) because the octagon corner cells hold the earlier balustrade. Only parts/room-36.mjs was edited.
left: Other parts still report refused writes in make.sh output (entrance hall, parlour library, dining room, butler's pantry, powder room, kitchen, bedroom 3, bedroom 5, bedroom 6, ground gallery, cottage bath, greenhouse). Those are outside this fix and were not touched.
roof off-palette (tuff_brick_slab, tuff_bricks, cobbled_deepslate_stairs, and others) is reported by the roof step, not this part. Fixing roof.json is outside this fix.

The moved lanterns hang from the cone's y7 course, which the plan says is solid; mcd check shows no gazebo cell among its structure warnings, but nothing confirms the y7 blocks themselves beyond that.

waste.what: Finding which cells an earlier part occupied: make.sh prints only the refused cell and what is there, so I had to read the cell list by hand and re-derive the octagon corner positions from the plan's radius-3 gazebo geometry.
waste.cost: about 2 make.sh runs plus reading the octagon geometry from the plan; about 10 minutes of re-derivation
waste.tool: A preflight from `layers()` (or a `mcd plan`-style grid print) that marks occupied cells in the part's own footprint and suggests the nearest free air cell for each refused write, so the fix is a lookup, not a re-derivation.
